a11y.apg: No role of its own and no keyboard: it is the Base UI Toolbar Group, which clusters related controls inside the toolbar. The roving tabindex belongs to Toolbar; the group only groups. Pass `label` when the cluster needs a name.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the sub-group. Without it the group is only visual.

props.name: children
props.description: Buttons that belong together inside the toolbar.
